observations.name: role_admission
observations.finding: ECS cluster targets require RoleArn. Malformed RoleArn and missing EcsParameters are whole-request ValidationException errors. Well-formed nonexistent roles, wrong-trust roles, and ecs:RunTask-denied roles are admitted with FailedEntryCount=0; admission does not prove delivery authorization.

observations.name: caller_passrole
observations.finding: A caller allowed events:PutTargets but not iam:PassRole receives whole-request AccessDeniedException naming the EventBridge invocation role. This is separate from invocation-role permission to pass the ECS execution role.

observations.name: ecs_parameter_admission
observations.finding: Missing TaskCount and LaunchType are accepted; TaskCount=10 accepted and 11 rejected by native ValidationException. Malformed task-definition ARN is rejected, but a well-formed nonexistent definition is accepted. Invalid LaunchType/PublicIp enum and empty subnet list are native whole-request errors. FARGATE requires nonempty NetworkConfiguration; AssignPublicIp ENABLED with EC2 is rejected. Invalid platform version, nonexistent subnet ID, and simultaneous LaunchType+CapacityProviderStrategy are accepted at PutTargets only; they were not delivered.

observations.name: client_validation_boundary
observations.finding: The CLI, not EventBridge, rejected missing TaskDefinitionArn and TaskCount 0/-1 with ParamValidation; these rows do not establish native response codes.

observations.name: whole_request_not_entry_failure
observations.finding: All accepted admission probes returned FailedEntryCount=0. Native invalid-field probes returned whole-request ValidationException, not FailedEntries. A mixed valid/missing-role request was rejected and its valid entry was not installed; prior probe entry remained.

observations.name: input_override_execution
observations.finding: Input is decoded as ECS overrides. The first task ran the specified shell command, received MARKER=native-input, emitted INPUT_OVERRIDE:native-input, and stopped with exit code 0 rather than the definition's exit 17.

observations.name: inputpath_rejected
observations.finding: ECS target InputPath is rejected at PutTargets: only Input and InputTransformer are accepted. The emitted inputpath event therefore had no installed target.

observations.name: transformer_override_execution
observations.finding: InputTransformer interpolated $.detail.marker into a container environment override. The task emitted TRANSFORM_OVERRIDE:native-transform and stopped with exit code 0.

observations.name: unknown_payload_fields_ignored
observations.finding: Input containing only {hello:not-an-override} was accepted and produced RunTask overrides={}, not arbitrary stdin/event payload. The task executed the task-definition BASELINE command and exited 17.

observations.name: target_to_runtask_mapping
observations.finding: CloudTrail RunTask request shows Target.Arn->cluster, TaskDefinitionArn->taskDefinition, TaskCount->count, LaunchType->launchType, NetworkConfiguration->networkConfiguration with lower-camel ECS names, PlatformVersion->platformVersion, Group->group, ReferenceId->referenceId, EnableECSManagedTags->enableECSManagedTags, EnableExecuteCommand->enableExecuteCommand, PropagateTags->propagateTags, and Tags Key/Value->tags key/value. Input/InputTransformer become overrides. EventBridge supplies startedBy=events-rule/<rule-name> (without custom bus name) and a clientToken; CloudTrail also records dryrun=false. RoleArn selects assumed caller identity and is not a RunTask request field. Unspecified group resolves to family:<definition-family>. ReferenceId is present in RunTask audit but absent from DescribeTasks output.

observations.name: task_tags
observations.finding: Target tags, TASK_DEFINITION propagated tags, and managed aws:ecs:clusterName are all present on the first task. Other delivered tasks with these options absent have empty tags. Explicit EnableExecuteCommand=false is reflected in task output.

observations.name: delivery_iam_responsibilities
observations.finding: Invocation role trusts events.amazonaws.com and needs ecs:RunTask on the definition in the cluster plus iam:PassRole for the definition execution role. Explicit ecs:RunTask deny and missing iam:PassRole both reached ECS and generated NO_PERMISSIONS DLQ messages. Wrong trust generated FAILED_TO_ASSUME_ROLE naming sts:AssumeRole. The execution role trusts ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com and allowed CloudWatch Logs; public image pull did not require private ECR credentials. No taskRoleArn was configured in this capture.

observations.name: invalid_container_delivery
observations.finding: Valid JSON overrides naming an absent container are admitted by PutTargets, then rejected by ECS InvalidParameterException. CloudTrail correlates the exact error; EventBridge sent INVALID_PARAMETER to the DLQ. No task was created for that call.

observations.name: dlq_native_metadata
observations.finding: With MaximumRetryAttempts=0 and MaximumEventAgeInSeconds=60, observed failures had ERROR_CODE, ERROR_MESSAGE, RULE_ARN, TARGET_ARN attributes; no RETRY_ATTEMPTS or EXHAUSTED_RETRY_CONDITION attributes appeared. DLQ body for these Input targets is the transformed/static overrides input, not the original custom event. These bounded non-retriable samples do not establish retry timing or retry-budget behavior.

observations.name: execution_bound
observations.finding: Three total Fargate tasks used cpu=256/memory=512. Created/stopped timestamps establish at most two concurrent task lifetimes. All three reached STOPPED with exit codes 0,0,17; observation ended within 12 minutes.

observations.name: task_definition_arn_admission
observations.finding: PutTargets accepts a task-definition family ARN without revision, revision 0 and leading-zero numeric revisions; existence/revision eligibility remains for RunTask. Nonnumeric and wildcard revisions, wrong resource kind and invalid family characters are rejected. Task definition region and account must match the target cluster. EcsParameters on an SQS target are rejected.

observations.name: ecs_target_readback_defaults
observations.finding: ListTargetsByRule materializes omitted TaskCount=1, EnableECSManagedTags=false and EnableExecuteCommand=false while preserving the supplied task-definition identifier spelling.

cleanup.taskStatus: All three owned tasks STOPPED; running list empty before cluster deletion
cleanup.clusterStatus: INACTIVE (normal retained ECS cluster tombstone), including collision cluster
notes: Initial shared-kernel collision cluster was deleted by the sibling; own verification observes INACTIVE. Other collision-created resources were cleaned by this capture.
Definition deletion was accepted without failures; final DescribeTaskDefinition still shows DELETE_IN_PROGRESS. Do not interpret as immediate disappearance.
No owned ENIs remained before networking removal; subsequent describe calls confirm VPC, subnet, gateway, security group and route table absent.

limitations: A shared Eval-kernel collision initially created owned resources under the sibling service prefix; those initial setup calls are retained and cleanup is explicit. No delivery used those resources.
No cross-account targets, EC2 capacity execution, capacity-provider execution, task-role vending, execute-command enablement, placement policies or nonzero retry-budget timing are established.

CloudTrail lookup is a bounded eventually-consistent sample. Matched six ECS calls (three successes, two IAM denials, one invalid-container failure). Missing history is never proof no request occurred.
Caller-role STS session acquisition was kept outside retained output to avoid credentials; the role setup and actual denied PutTargets caller ARN are recorded.

SQS receipt handles and CloudTrail access-key identifiers are redacted; inputJSON otherwise preserves actual CLI input JSON. CloudTrail itself redacts command/environment fields in some audit request/response shapes.
Shared Eval collision setup rows use the sibling service prefix but are exclusively owned test resources. This fixture owns definition revision 1 only, not sibling-created later revisions.
